svg.desc: 14,850 GitHub contributions across 142 active days, 2025-10-19 to 2026-10-18. An automatically played breakout animation. Stronger contribution levels take more hits. A long streak unlocks multiball. The original calendar returns each loop.

g.text: Built one day at a time.
